summary: Validated year-based filter that hides APPROVED vacation requests of previous years on /vacations. Backend (2 endpoints) and Frontend (Meus Pedidos + admin Todos os Colaboradores) all confirmed working. 8/8 backend tests pass; UI matches expectations.

issues: Pre-existing (unrelated to this fix): one card shows '25/02/2026 até 25/02/2026' with text 'dias' (no number) because days_requested=0 for that justified-day record. Not a regression.

critical_code_review_comments: vacations.py:127-136 uses string comparison `{$gte: 'YYYY-01-01'}` on start_date — works because start_date is stored as ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' string. Lexicographic order matches chronological order. OK.
vacations.py:290-348 mirrors the same filter for admin endpoint. Both use date.today().year computed at request time (correct, reflects server timezone).
test_credentials: miguel / Miguel123! (admin). Has approved entries in 2026 (23/01, 20/02, 25/02, 01/03-28/03) and 3 rejected entries on 2025-10-20.
seed_data_creation: None - relied on existing miguel data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_vacation_year_filter.py validates the year filter for /api/vacations/my-requests and /api/admin/vacations/all-balances and that /api/vacations/balance is unchanged. Must export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest. Frontend at /vacations confirmed: 'Meus Pedidos' shows only 2026 approved + 2025 rejected (3 rejected entries from 2025-10-20 remain visible because non-approved). Admin 'Todos os Colaboradores' tab also filters approved_requests by current year.
rca of the issue: Filter implemented as MongoDB query on start_date string (ISO format). For my-requests: {$or:[{status:{$ne:'approved'}},{start_date:{$gte:'2026-01-01'}}]} — keeps non-approved of any year and only current-year approved. For all-balances: status='approved' AND start_date>='2026-01-01'. Both endpoints verified via API and UI render.
